svg.title: 10 MycoSNP runs vs 1 CorgiSNPs run
svg.desc: For Candidozyma auris clades I to V, MycoSNP needs ten separate runs to assign clades, build clade-specific phylogenies and detect FKS1 resistance. CorgiSNPs does the same in one run that branches by clade and joins back together.
svg.text: FKS1 vs Clade I ref · runs 6–10
FKS1 via Clade I ref, automatically
Lines represent clades I–V of Candidozyma auris
